predecessors.name: Bagratid Armenia
predecessors.text: Artsakh, which the infobox lists as a vassal of the Armenian kingdom around 1000

successors.name: Melikdoms of Karabakh
successors.text: the Khamsa, the five melikdoms of Karabakh, under a Persian protectorate from 1603

rulers.name: Hasan-Jalal Dola
rulers.title: prince of Khachen, last king of Artsakh

ledger.x: c. 1000: the Kingdom of Artsakh (Khachen) appears. Infobox 'Established: 1000', a vassal of the Armenian kingdom around 1000; 'Contemporary sources referred to it as the Khachen.'
1214: the house of Hasan-Jalal begins to rule Khachen and Artsakh.
1261: Hasan-Jalal is assassinated and the kingdom becomes the principality of Khachen.
1603: Persia puts the Khamsa under a protectorate.

wars.name: Ilkhanid killing of Hasan-Jalal
wars.outcome: Hasan-Jalal Dola, last king of Artsakh, was assassinated by the Ilkhanid ruler Arghun in 1261 and the rulers lost the royal title.

wars.name: Persian protectorate over the Khamsa
wars.outcome: The Persians established a protectorate over the Khamsa in 1603; the melikdoms kept Armenian autonomy through the Persian-Ottoman wars.

certainty.note: Mountain principality: no page gives a boundary; the Karabakh region is a soft reading.
